paper_id: Impaired regional structure-function coupling as novel neurophenotype_ mechanistic insights and diagnostic exploration in treatment-resistant depression
title: Impaired regional structure-function coupling as novel neurophenotype: mechanistic insights and diagnostic exploration in treatment-resistant depression
motivation: TRD诊断依赖症状和试药,缺乏早期识别标志物,延误治疗增加自杀风险和疾病负担
problem_framing: 将结构-功能耦合(SFC)定义为GMV与ALFF的概率分布相似度,对比TRD/nTRD/HC三组差异
key_insight: 右侧额中回等区域的SFC解耦是TRD特异性神经表型,可作为影像标志物用于鉴别诊断
method_signature: KL散度计算区域GMV-ALFF耦合,XGBoost/SVM二分类,双 atlas验证+半样本重复
evaluation_criteria: ROC-AUC/准确率/特异度/敏感度,FDR多重比较校正
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: TRD病程延长可能掩盖SFC变化,早期识别仍有挑战;相关性分析在全患者组整体不显著,需亚组分析
evidence_for_taste: Neither ALFF nor GMV differences alone reproduced the spatial pattern
coupling alterations are not driven by a unimodal change
longer illness duration in TRD may obscure detection of SFC changes
greater structural–functional dissociation has been associated with hindered network efficiency
among the first to provide neurobiological diagnostic markers for TRD
weak correlations between SFC and clinical symptoms were observed
thinking_moves: 单模态研究忽视结构-功能交互,转向多模态耦合分析
先验证SFC变化非单模态驱动,而是协调性改变
对比unimodal方法与SFC方法,强调SFC的互补价值
相关性弱则细分亚组挖掘group-specific模式
解释为何TRD失去相关性:系统衰竭失去代偿链接
用机器学习将神经特征转化为临床可用的鉴别工具
